offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures tractors, combines, planters, construction machines and forestry equipment, plus precision farming technology, for farmers, contractors and forestry operators. Sold mainly through independent dealers, with financing and leasing offered through its captive finance arm, and it also sells turf equipment to homeowners and landscapers.

primary_products.value: tractors; combines and harvesters; planting and tillage equipment; construction machinery; forestry equipment

primary_services.value: equipment financing and leasing; repair and maintenance; precision agriculture software and data services

customer_segment.value: B2B: farmers, ranchers, construction contractors, forestry operators, landscaping businesses; B2C: homeowners buying lawn and garden tractors and mowers; B2G: municipalities and government agencies buying construction and turf equipment

end_markets.value: agriculture; construction; forestry; turf and landscaping

revenue_model.value: product sales: equipment, attachments and replacement parts sold through dealers and retailers; subscription: precision agriculture technology and software subscriptions; service fees: repair, maintenance and technology support services; interest or premiums: interest on equipment financing and premiums on insurance products; rental or leasing: equipment leases offered through its financial services arm
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; service fees; interest or premiums; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds machines in its own plants, sold to dealers and end users; software / platform: farm management and precision guidance systems sold to growers and fleet owners; financial intermediary: finances equipment purchases for farmers, contractors and dealers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: North America, South America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Africa and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: diversified: agricultural equipment, construction equipment, forestry equipment, turf equipment and financial services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent dealers selling and servicing equipment for farm and construction customers; third-party retail: home improvement and outdoor retailers selling lawn and garden equipment; online: online parts ordering and equipment sales information for customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions, product safety and transport rules, plus financial services lending regulations
